content:
Maya Patel: Hey — PR #4922 is ready for final merge but Netlify preview shows a missing sidebar on a couple pages, can someone quick-eyeball? https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1945678900
Sam O'Neill: I can take a look. Which commit?
Maya Patel: commit 4f7b2c1 (rebased onto main earlier today). Local mkdocs looks fine for me though.
docs-ci-bot: Netlify deploy finished: succeeded with warnings. Artifact upload: 1 warning.
Sam O'Neill: okay pulling the preview now. Quick scan — console shows 404 for /assets/js/sidebar.js and the hashed asset in the artifact index is different.
Sam O'Neill: paste of the error from the Netlify log:
```
WARN  Failed to copy: assets/js/sidebar.18a2d.js -> assets/js/sidebar.9f1b3.js (not found in artifact shard)
WARN  Artifact shard mismatch: expected 4 files, found 3
```
Olivia Chen: hmm that sounds like an artifact sharding race we saw last week. Maya, did you change any custom asset hashing or the webpack config in this PR?
Maya Patel: only small CSS tweak and bumped the mkdocs-material version, no webpack edits. The build pipeline hasn't changed.
Jordan Lee: could be the preview builder running parallel shard uploads then deduping. Quick local check: can you run `pipx run mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000` and confirm sidebar present? Also `mkdocs build && ls -R site/assets/js | grep sidebar` to see the generated name.
Maya Patel: running that now — `mkdocs build` shows `site/assets/js/sidebar.18a2d.js` locally. Netlify preview expects `sidebar.9f1b3.js` per the artifact index.
Sam O'Neill: simplest workaround: rebuild the preview by pushing an empty commit to the branch to trigger a fresh deploy: `git commit --allow-empty -m "rebuild preview: asset shard retry" && git push`
Maya Patel: ok I'll do the empty commit if we don't find a root cause quickly.
Olivia Chen: before that, let's try clearing the Netlify cache via the deploy UI (if you have perms) — that sometimes fixes stale artifact indices.
Maya Patel: I don't have org-level permissions. Can someone with perms try? @Jordan Lee can you?
Jordan Lee: on it — clearing cache + redeploy now. (I clicked "Clear cache and deploy site")
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for branch: docs/pr/4922 — deploy id 202-1945679120 — status: queued
Sam O'Neill: thanks. If that still fails, empty commit push will be next. If both fail we should open an infra issue; but try cache clear first.
Jordan Lee: redeploy finished — looks green, hand-checking pages.
Jordan Lee: sidebar is back on the pages I checked.
Maya Patel: awesome thanks Jordan. Anyone able to review the content side for accuracy? @Sam @Olivia @Jordan
Sam O'Neill: quick pass done — docs content looks good, small nit in the SDK snippet line wrapping but not blocking.
Olivia Chen: LGTM from me, just add a one-line changelog entry.
Jordan Lee: LGTM. One more ask: squash the fixup commit into the feature commit so the history is clean for the release notes.
Maya Patel: will squash and push. My plan: merge during the 11:30–12:00 merge slot unless someone objects.
Sam O'Neill: no objections.
Olivia Chen: no objections.
Maya Patel: squash done and pushed. Merge queued.
deploy-bot: Merge check: CI status — docs-ci-bot: success, main branch checks: pass.
docs-ci-bot: Netlify preview matches artifact index after rebuild.
Maya Patel: merging now, thanks all :tada:
Sam O'Neill: nice, thanks for coordinating.
Jordan Lee: FYI for future: if you hit artifact shard issues again, add `NETLIFY_CACHE_STRATEGY=clean` to the deploy env for that run or purge cache via UI before rebuilding — saves pushing empty commits.
Maya Patel: good tip, noted.
